converter-moved.heading: This tool has moved
converter-moved.body: The standalone Image Converter has been retired. Image conversion — HEIC, AVIF, WebP, JPEG XL, GIF and more — now lives inside MemeMaker's Batch Convert & Optimize feature, running on the same fully client-side engine with no uploads.
